Classification: Low Clan

The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ssX4b2JFXF2uegC3]{Followers of Set} claim descent directly from the Egyptian god Set, disputing any tie to Caine at all. They trace their history to Set's ancient war against his brother Osiris and nephew Horus, and to Set's mysterious vanishing from his sarcophagus in the first century, after which he plagued his eldest childer with prophetic dreams. Setites deal in vice, corruption and heresy, believing darkness breeds humility while light breeds hubris. Traditional Setites, led by a priestly caste of Hierophants, kept the bloodline largely to Africans and Saracens; a newer generation of "Descendants" now breeds carelessly in Europe, creating friction between traditionalists and this expanding, undisciplined branch.

Disciplines: Obfuscate, Presence, Serpentis

Advantage: Every Setite gains one bonus Streetwise Ability Trait and a level of Political, Street or Underworld Influence.

Disadvantage: Setites are sensitive to light. Sunlight always inflicts an extra health level of damage, and bright artificial light (spotlights, flares, floodlights) causes a one-Trait penalty on all challenges.

Organization: Governed by the Hierophant caste, with an increasingly independent and undisciplined population of Deshera ("the red ones") establishing nests outside Egypt.

Suggested Viae: Beast, Kings, Sin. The most orthodox follow the Road of the Serpent.
